comment: Bot-free live input proof on Arena Duel. No teleport, no jump during stair walking. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_NO_ROUND_EVENTS=1, and FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/movement.json.

states.name: jump_input
states.note: Sub-frame Space tap rises and lands through actual input, server, and camera.

states.name: stair_approach
states.note: Walk around the spawn pocket to the outer east stairs.

states.name: outer_stair_top
states.note: Walk up six fractional-height treads without jumping.

states.name: inner_stair_bottom
states.note: Cross the gantry and walk down the inner east stairs.

states.name: inner_stair_top
states.note: Walk up the repaired inner north entrance and fractional treads.

states.name: ledge_exit
states.note: Walk off the gantry, land, and keep moving beyond its inflated edge.
